description: Three new open-access ACL 2025 papers covering scientific table/text QA, multimodal retrieval, and hierarchical table reasoning.
reclassification_reason: The first isolated Hybrid retrieval diagnostic reached target-document hit rate 1.000 but only 8/12 complete required-fact cases at @50 (macro 0.694, micro 0.658). Four cases exposed unresolved wide-table statistics and multi-column value coverage gaps; this set is no longer an unseen confirmation set.
freeze_policy: Do not tune retrieval, parsing, or answer formatting against this set. Any failure discovered after retrieval or generation requires reclassification as development-regression and a new unseen set.
